SI = P*R*T/100
=> 4P = P*R*10/100
=> R = 40%
New rate of interest per annum = (100 + 20)% of 40 = 120% of 40 = 1.2*40 = 48%
Simple interest @ 48% per annum = P*48*10/100 = 4.8P
According to the question, 4.8P - 4P = 0.8P = 160
=> P = 200
Also,
1500 = 40*T*200/100
=> 80T = 1500
=> T = 150/8 = 18.75 years = 18 years 9 months
